In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the proposed BP-CNN architecture is a promising approach to exploit the noise correlation for iterative channel decoding, which can achieve significant performance improvement over conventional BP decoding.
the proposed BP-CNN architecture can significantly improve the performance of the standard BP decoder under correlated noise.

, the iterative BP-CNN framework is able to improve the performance of the standard BP decoder under correlated noise, and the normality test loss function can further improve the performance of BP-CNN by shaping the residual noise distribution.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, with the proposed BP-CNN architecture, we can achieve better performance than the state-of-the-art deep learning based channel decoders, especially for low to moderate SNRs.

, with the proposed BP-CNN architecture, the iterative decoding with the proposed loss function outperforms the standard iterative decoding by up to 1.5 dB in terms of BER at the bit error rate of 10-6.
the proposed framework is capable of improving the decoding performance of convolutional codes under correlated noise, and it can be easily extended to other iterative decoding schemes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the CNN can be trained to learn the noise correlation and hence improve the decoding performance.
the BP-CNN framework can be applied to a wide range of decoding algorithms and can be trained to achieve better decoding performance than the standard BP decoder.
the proposed BP-CNN architecture can be trained to achieve a near-optimal BER performance for channel decoding with correlated noise, which is a very challenging problem.
